cell.label: two_arcs_60deg
cell.name: 1-3__two_arcs_60deg
cell.rationale: path 1-3 at delta = 60 deg: two distinct components, each an arc cut by exit TIR at one end and by the entry ray leaving face 1 (path_infeasible) at the other (test_path_1_3_at_60_deg_is_two_distinct_components)

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

accepted_pose_regularity.basis: exact: at every accepted pose every branch margin is positive and normal_jacobian > 0 (contract sections 6.1 and 5.4: an accepted pose is on the smooth branch and regular)

arclength_relative.basis: docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 10.1: discrete lengths of one 3-5 loop span 0.0017 on 0.9645 (1.8e-3 relative) across initial steps 0.03-0.08; an arc's length is compared only from the same seed (section 9.5.6)

curve_distance_rad.basis: docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 10.1: bidirectional sampled-pose set distance below 0.012 rad between two step-controller settings on the 3-5 loop; measured here against the geodesic polyline (curve_distance), which removes the chord-sampling part of that distance

pointwise_consistency.basis: per trace and pose i: jacobian_available[i] is true, and normal_jacobian[i], singular_values[i] and branch_margins[i] equal the backend's own EvaluatePath at poses[i] within the evaluate_path tolerances at that pose (value 1e-12 is their base: kinematic_atol for margins, jacobian_rtol for J_perp); a per-sample comparison with LI is not made, because two backends step differently

status_reason.basis: exact; with two traces the pair {reason of each} is compared unordered, because the seed tangent sign is deterministic per LAPACK build only (docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 10.1, seed orientation)
